visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of raw white rice being rinsed thoroughly in a metal sieve while held over a sink. (2) The sieve containing the wet rice is placed inside a metal bowl filled with water to soak, with a red cast-iron pot visible in the blurred background. (3) Hands lift the metal sieve out of the soaking bowl, allowing excess water to drain back into the bowl. (4) The scene shifts to a red cast-iron pot on an induction stove; hands pour a small amount of olive oil from a light blue bottle into the empty pot. (5) Hands carefully transfer the soaked and drained white rice from the sieve into the red cast-iron pot. (6) A hand is seen adding a small pinch of salt from a white container into the pot with the rice. (7) Clear water is poured from a plastic measuring cup directly into the red pot containing the rice and oil. (8) The camera focuses on the induction stove's control panel as a hand touches the glass surface to turn the heat setting to maximum. (9) A hand uses a wooden rice paddle to gently stir the rice and water mixture inside the pot to ensure it's level. (10) The water in the pot begins to boil rapidly with white foam and bubbles appearing on the surface. (11) A hand places a heavy black lid onto the red pot to begin the steaming process. (12) A hand displays a blue digital timer showing exactly 8 minutes, then places it next to the pot. (13) The hand touches the induction stove again to turn off the heat once the timer completes. (14) The blue timer is shown again, this time displaying 15 minutes for the resting period. (15) Hands wearing pink floral oven mitts lift the lid of the red pot, releasing a cloud of steam and revealing fluffy cooked rice. (16) A hand uses a white plastic rice paddle to fluff up the cooked rice, showing its texture. (17) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt and purple apron, smiles at the camera while holding a small red bowl filled with rice. (18) She uses wooden chopsticks to take a bite of the rice, looking satisfied and happy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, bright acoustic piano melody begins, joined by light strings. High-frequency water splashing sounds occur as the rice is washed. (2) A metallic scraping sound as the sieve is lifted. The BGM remains steady at ~110 BPM with a happy tonality. (3) Liquid pouring sound followed by the soft crunching texture of rice grains being moved. A sharp metallic 'click' signifies the stove being turned on. (4) Boiling and bubbling sounds increase in spectral density. A dull percussive thud occurs as the lid is placed on the pot. (5) A high-pitched digital 'ding' sound effects a transition. (6) A friendly, high-pitched female voice begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a joyful intonation. Sound of a lid lifting and steam escaping. (7) Soft scraping of a paddle against cooked rice. The female voice continues with high arousal and positive valence. (8) Clear 'crunch' and chewing sounds as she tastes the rice. The piano music swells slightly to a close.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Preparation -> Cooking -> Resting -> Results -> Endorsement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a specific, effective method for cooking fluffy white rice using a cast-iron pot, while subtly promoting high-end cookware through a friendly and relatable tutorial format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent use and visual highlighting of a Le Creuset cast-iron pot and matching induction stove throughout the tutorial, paired with positive subtitles about the results.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production value with crisp foley sounds and bright lighting to create an aspirational kitchen aesthetic typical of premium lifestyle content.
